info.title: HM Land Registry Open Data
info.description: Price Paid Data (every registered property sale in England and Wales since 1995) and the UK House Price Index, both keyless linked-data APIs. Postcodes are CASE-SENSITIVE and uppercase with the space, e.g. 'E1 6AN'.

get.summary: Registered property sales at a full postcode, most recent first
get.description: Every recorded sale at the postcode since 1995. `result.items[]` carries `pricePaid` (GBP), `transactionDate` (display string, server-sorted), `propertyAddress` (paon/street/town), `propertyType.prefLabel[0]._value` and `newBuild`.

parameters.name: propertyAddress.postcode
parameters.description: Full postcode, UPPERCASE with space, e.g. 'SE10 9JY'.

200.description: Sales under result.items; empty when the postcode has no registered sales.

get.summary: The UK House Price Index for a local authority — monthly average prices and annual change
get.description: `result.items[]` (with `_view=all`) carries `averagePrice`, `averagePriceDetached/FlatMaisonette/Terraced/SemiDetached`, `refMonth` and index values. The region is the local authority as a lowercase slug, e.g. `greenwich`, `tower-hamlets`, `city-of-westminster`.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Local-authority slug: lowercase, spaces to hyphens.

parameters.name: _view
parameters.description: Use `all` so items come back as full records.
